title: Positivity under tape embedding
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\sigma$ inject the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and let $C$ be a contract for an $m$-tape machine. If $C$ has strictly positive assigned time for every datum and every starting configuration in its entry state satisfying its precondition, then the contract induced by embedding $C$ into the $k$-tape machine also has strictly positive assigned time for every datum and every eligible starting configuration.
